name: agripparc-1.4

props.description: Which prop declaration method to use

children.description: Whether the component is meant to have children (FC) or not (VFC)

flat.description: Whether to create a new, dedicated dir for the component (false) or not (true)

stylingModule.description: Relevant for `css` or `scss` styling. If true, generates a scoped `module` stylesheet

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files, if any are found

postCommand.description: A command to run after a component was successfully generated

baseDir.description: Path to a base directory which components should be genenrated in or relative to

destination.description: The path in which the component folder/files should be generated, relative to baseDir

allowOutsideBase.description: If true, allows components to be generated outside the resolved baseDir

exportType.description: Whether to use a named export or a default export for the component

declaration.description: Whether to declare the component as a const with an arrow function or a function declaration

tsPropsDeclaration.description: For TS components, whether to declare props as an interface or a type

memo.description: Whether to generate a memo() component. Overrides the declaration option

separateIndex.description: Whether to use a dedicated index file (recommended)

reactNative.description: Whether to generate React Native components

debug.description: Whether to log additional debug information

schema.title: JSON schema for the Agrippa config file

description: The component generation will follow the configuration defined at https://json.schemastore.org/agripparc-1.4.json. We are using TypeScript (typescript true) with props declared via TypeScript (props "ts") and the props shape expressed as an interface (tsPropsDeclaration "interface"). The component is intended to be a functional component that accepts children (children true), will be written as a const arrow function (declaration "const") and wrapped in React.memo (memo true). It will be exported as the default export (exportType "default") and a dedicated index file will be created (separateIndex true). Styled‑components will be used for styling (styling "styled-components") without a CSS module (stylingModule false). React will be imported (importReact true), but we will not overwrite existing files (overwrite false). The generation target is under the base directory ./src/components (baseDir) in the sub‑folder ui/buttons (destination), and generation outside that base is disallowed (allowOutsideBase false). The component will not be a React‑Native component (reactNative false), and debugging output is turned off (debug false). After the files are created, the command npm run lint (postCommand) will be executed automatically. The overall layout will be a nested folder structure rather than a flat one (flat false).
